name: PT Pelangi Indah Canindo Tbk
summary: PT Pelangi Indah Canindo Tbk manufactures and sells metal packaging products in Indonesia. It operates through Printing; Pailcan; Drum; Component; and Plastic Drum segments. The company offers steel drums, plastic drums, LPG cylinder tanks, pail cans, and food cans. It also provides metal printing services. PT Pelangi Indah Canindo Tbk was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
